greeting: Good morning, Rick! Happy Friday the 13th, here's what's new in tech today.

items.title: Starship set for a historic test flight from Texas today
items.note: SpaceX plans to launch Starship from South Texas this afternoon, with the window opening at 4:45 PM Central. For the first time it will try to catch both the booster and the ship back at the launch site, the ship landing on Saturday after about 14 trips around the Earth.

items.title: iOS 27's Find My lets you share your location for a set time
items.note: Find My on your iPhone now has a Custom option, so you can share your location for a few hours, a few days, or until a date you pick. Handy for a trip or a game day, and it shuts off by itself so you don't have to remember.

items.title: Early Black Friday Apple deals: AirTag 2 at an all-time low
items.note: Amazon has a 4-pack of AirTag 2 for $70 (about $17.50 each) and AirPods Pro 3 for $199. Official Apple Watch bands start around $32 too.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster and more accurate AI
items.note: Google's new everyday AI model is much faster and makes up facts far less often, according to Google. It is now powering Google Search answers for everyone, while the Gemini app version is for paid subscribers for now.

items.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will testify before Congress
items.note: A follow-up to yesterday's big story: Huang agreed to answer lawmakers' questions before Thanksgiving, likely behind closed doors. Colette Kress is running Nvidia while the company looks for a permanent CEO.

items.title: A flying car you could learn to pilot in 5 minutes
items.note: Xpeng's Aridge is a big van that carries a two-seat drone in the back, which folds out and flies about 19 miles. It costs around $300,000, already has 17,000 orders overseas, and US approval work starts next year.

items.title: American Cancer Society now urges routine prostate cancer screening
items.note: New guidelines say men at average risk should get a PSA blood test every two years from 50 to 69, and men 70 to 74 should talk it over with their doctor. Worth bringing up at your next checkup.

items.title: New Apple TV comedy with Elizabeth Banks and Ted Danson
items.note: She's Fine follows a newly divorced mom who gets roped into her dad's lively retirement community, with Tom Selleck as a guest star. It premieres January 27 with two episodes, a fun one to put on the list with Jen.
